feed_title: Bolster Dog Bed with Three Sides, Charcoal and Beige, Zipped Washable Cover, Medium 70 x 55cm to XL 100 x 75cm | PawLunova Harrogate
descriptionHtml:
Charcoal and beige. Three bolsters. It can stay in the room.

Harrogate is a bolster dog bed in charcoal and beige, with three bolsters around a cushioned base and a zipped washable cover, in Medium, Large and XL.

Think about where the bed goes when people come round. Behind an armchair, or out into the hall, and the dog spends the evening lying by the door instead of with you.

Charcoal and beige sit quietly beside grey sofas and wood floors. Nothing about it demands to be hidden, so it stays put and so does the dog.

What they get

  • Three bolsters round a filled base: The head goes on an edge, the body in the middle.
  • A charcoal and beige finish: Understated enough to leave out when guests arrive.
  • A soft filled base: Yielding rather than firm. For firm support, look at our memory foam beds.
  • A zipped outer cover: It lifts off for the wash, following the sewn-in instructions.
  • Three sizes, 70 × 55cm to 100 × 75cm: Listed outside dimensions.

Best for: Dogs who rest a head on an edge, and rooms with a neutral palette.

Why it is worth the money

£49 for the Medium and £79 for the XL. That is the least we ask for a three-sided bolster with a cover that unzips, and the finish is the point. Charcoal and beige is the palette people actually live with, so it stays in the living room rather than the utility.

The trade-off is honest. The base is filled, not foam. It gives under weight rather than holding a dog level, so a big heavy dog who wants proper support is better served by memory foam.

Size and fit

SizeListed dimensions (cm)
Medium70 × 55
Large85 × 65
XL100 × 75

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside figures and the bolsters take part of them, so compare against the usable space inside the sides. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Take the cover off and follow the sewn-in washing instructions. Let it air-dry fully before you put it back on.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

Take their length on their side, add 15 to 20cm, then judge the space inside.

How much is delivery, and how quickly does it arrive?

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Timings appear at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment choices appear when you reach checkout.

Is the base firm or soft?

Soft. A cushioned filled base, not foam, so they sink in rather than sit level.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

We describe the bed and leave the rest to your vet. A soft filled base, three bolsters, one side left open.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The outer cover is zipped and washes at the temperature on its label. Air-dry it.

What if my dog just won't use it?

You have 100 nights. Tell us, and we collect free and refund in full.

Choose their size and leave the bed where the family sits.
